title: RUSH LLM Output Format
description: Structured output format that every LLM labeler must return. This schema also defines the .md prompt section describing the expected output.

label.description: L0 decision. For warm-start: violative/non_violative. For cold-start GenAI: gen_ai/not_gen_ai.

l1_label.description: L1 enforcement action (warm-start only). Values: ignore/hide/deactivate. Omit for cold-start.

l2_label.description: L2 subcategory node_id from the policy graph. Must reference a valid node in the current policy version.

justification.description: Grounded justification citing specific policy sections, criteria, or boundary warnings that led to the decision.

confidence.description: Model self-assessed confidence in the label. Low confidence near boundaries is expected and useful.

difficulty.description: Labeler's assessment of case difficulty. High = near boundary, ambiguous, or policy-silent. Used to flag hard positives/negatives.

is_boundary.description: Whether the case sits near a decision boundary between positive and negative, or between subcategories. Critical signal for policy refinement.
